features.name: Link check
features.summary: Parse a link locally and compare the host with the bundled snapshots.
features.limitations: A miss is not a promise that the page is safe. Lists are not auto-updated.

features.name: Message check
features.summary: Paste a message. Links inside it are checked locally.
features.limitations: Pasted text cannot prove who sent it. Shield does not read your SMS or email app.

features.name: QR check
features.summary: Decode a QR image or the camera locally, then check the result before you open it.
features.limitations: The camera needs your permission. Shield does not open the link on its own.

features.name: File name and hash
features.summary: Local SHA-256, double-extension, and a few magic-byte checks.
features.limitations: This is not a malware scan.

features.name: Link cleaner
features.summary: Remove a conservative set of tracking parameters, with undo.
features.limitations: Signed, login, and payment links are left unchanged.

features.name: Password tools
features.summary: Web Crypto passwords and passphrases, plus a local strength estimate.
features.limitations: The passphrase is not a wallet recovery phrase. The estimate is not a guarantee.

features.name: Breached-password range check
features.summary: Optional check of a five-character SHA-1 prefix against the Pwned Passwords range API.
features.scope: This browser. The prefix is sent only if you ask.
features.limitations: Not an email search. A miss is not proof of strength.
features.costOwner: The range API is free to call. Shield adds no fee.

features.name: Secure Share
features.summary: Encrypt or decrypt a message or file you enter here, with a shared password.
features.limitations: Protects only that content. It does not encrypt other apps. GnuPG 2.4 cannot open what Shield writes. Shield can open passphrase messages from GnuPG 2.4.
features.costOwner: No fee. The library is LGPL-3.0-or-later.

features.name: Connection Doctor
features.summary: Browser hints, an optional public-IP lookup, and optional WebRTC candidate counts.
features.scope: This browser, and only the lookups you start.
features.limitations: These signals do not prove which SIM or tunnel is in use. Physical phones were not tested.

features.name: Location privacy
features.summary: Explains website permission, app permission, and IP-inferred location separately. The Chromium extension can block location and restore what it changed.
features.limitations: Firefox cannot set this from an extension. Phone app permissions are manual steps.

features.name: NXTL eSIM guidance
features.summary: London-exit explanation, setup steps, and live EUR-per-GB rates.
features.limitations: Buying data is optional and unlocks nothing here. Shield cannot see whether the NXTL line is active.
features.costOwner: NXTL eSIM is a separate paid service.

features.name: Encrypted DNS setup
features.summary: Download an Apple DNS profile or follow Android, Windows, Chrome, and Firefox steps for a public resolver you choose.
features.limitations: A download is not an installed profile. Shield does not run a resolver.
features.costOwner: Queries go to the resolver you pick.

features.name: Threat blocking in the browser
features.summary: The extension can warn on a capped copy of the bundled threat lists.
features.scope: This browser, after you turn the extension on.
features.limitations: The manual checker uses the full snapshot. The extension stays under the browser’s static-rule budget.

features.name: Tracker domains in the browser
features.summary: Optional off-by-default rules for tracker-like hosts.
features.limitations: Not a full cosmetic ad blocker, and not same-site ads.

features.name: Link cleaning in the browser
features.summary: The extension can strip the same conservative tracking parameters.
features.limitations: Signed-looking links are skipped when the rule matches.

features.name: Cookie-banner hiding
features.summary: The extension can hide a short list of common banners.
features.limitations: Hiding is not rejecting consent.

features.name: Reports, theme, and export
features.summary: Redacted check history stays in this browser. Light and dark follow the system or your choice.
features.limitations: Passwords and file bytes are not stored.

features.name: Install the page
features.summary: Use the browser install prompt when it exists, otherwise the steps for that browser.
features.limitations: Installing the page does not add system filtering or a tunnel.

features.name: Android companion
features.summary: A later signed app could add on-device filtering, call screening, and broader file checks.
features.limitations: No app is built in this version. See docs/android-companion.md.

features.name: Device-wide encrypted tunnel
features.summary: Shield does not run a tunnel or choose an exit city.
features.limitations: NXTL mobile data has its own published London exit. That is a connection, not this feature.

features.name: File-content malware scan
features.summary: No antivirus engine is bundled.
features.limitations: The file tool only hashes and checks the name and a few leading bytes.

features.name: Call screening
features.summary: No call-screening role and no number list.
features.limitations: A website cannot screen calls.

features.name: Password vault
features.summary: Shield does not store passwords.
features.limitations: Use a separate maintained vault if you need one.

features.name: Email breach monitoring
features.summary: Shield does not look up email addresses.
features.limitations: The password range check is not an email search.
